title: Zediit
wikitext:
Created by [[zedii]], Zediit offers QuakeWorld players to prove their skill, by completing specific set of tricks.

In comparison to such maps as [[ztricks]] or [[way2ez]], which involves a player to bunny across strategically calculated distances, Zediit offers the player the same challenge but with the use of weapons.

Consisting of 5 different tricks, Zediit is designed to challenge the user to their maximum potential in maintaining control, precision and patience by firing a specific weapon at specific targets, in order to accomplish the trick.
